original.prompt: Consider the following statements about Wholesale Price Index (WPI) based inflation for March 2026:
items: It was the highest reading since January 2023.
Fewer than half of the 22 industrial groups in the manufacturing sub-index posted price increases.
The manufacturing sub-index accounts for over 64% of the WPI.
original.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
original.explain: Statement 2 is wrong because 16 of the 22 manufacturing groups posted hikes, led by metals, chemicals and textiles. WPI inflation rose to 3.88% in March 2026 from 2.13% in February, its highest level since January 2023.
original.source: The manufacturing sub-index, comprising over 64% of the WPI, saw 16 of 22 industrial groups post hikes.

rewritten.prompt: Consider the following statements about Wholesale Price Index (WPI) based inflation for March 2026:
items: It was the highest reading since January 2024.
More than half of the 22 industrial groups in the manufacturing sub-index posted price increases.
The manufacturing sub-index accounts for over 64% of the WPI.
rewritten.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
rewritten.explain: Statement 1 is wrong because the March 2026 reading was the highest since January 2023, not January 2024. Statements 2 and 3 are correct, as 16 of the 22 manufacturing groups posted hikes and the sub-index makes up over 64% of the WPI. WPI inflation rose to 3.88% in March 2026 from 2.13% in February, driven largely by an 8.77% spike in mineral oils.
rewritten.source: The manufacturing sub-index, comprising over 64% of the WPI, saw 16 of 22 industrial groups post hikes.
